subject: SIG evidence: penetration test package and continuous validation proposal

From: Julia Sanders <julia.sanders@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Acme GRC Team <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request — pen test package and confirmation of cadence

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this. Acme is moving through our SIG review for the procurement committee and they flagged the pen test evidence section. Two quick asks we hope you can help with:  

1) Can you provide the pen test evidence package you reference in the SIG (scope, signed report, workpapers or evidence manifest, and a redaction-ready PDF)? We need to attach something to the SIG spreadsheet and to our security team.

2) Our reviewers also want to understand whether Redwood treats pen tests as an annual, point-in-time engagement or as part of a continuous validation program (e.g., quarterly scans + annual external engagement). If you have a short description of your cadence and acceptance criteria for report age (for example: "report must be within 12 months of contract signing"), that would be helpful.

If possible, can you get the initial packet by end of day Wednesday? We can accept a redacted report and an evidence manifest CSV.

Thanks — I can loop in our procurement lead if needed but wanted to start here.

Best,
Julia
Julia Sanders
Sr. GRC Analyst, Acme Health
julia.sanders@acmehealth.com

Julia —

Thanks — we can do that. Quick summary up front so your team has the high-level answers for the SIG spreadsheet:  

- Package we can provide: redacted signed PDF of the external pen test report, a short evidence manifest (CSV) listing test artifacts and delivery hashes, and a small sample of scan logs for reproducibility. We can also include the vendor's attestation of method and CVE sampling approach as a short PDF.
- Cadence: Redwood performs an annual external penetration test with an additional quarterly automated vulnerability scoring program that covers our publicly routable surfaces and critical internal services. For procurement acceptance we typically offer the most recent external report (within 12 months) plus the quarterly scans covering the 6 months prior to review.

I’m looping Karthik (security owner) to confirm the attachments and whether any of the workpapers need an NDA before we hand them over. Mina is looped for redaction/contract language if Acme needs a special carve-out.

We’ll work to get a redaction-ready package to you by Wed EOD.

Best,
Rishi

Julia / Acme GRC team —

Quick technical note from Security: our external pen test (conducted Nov 2026) was scoped to the following boundary for SIG purposes: public API endpoints, admin console, and the infra control plane (no production customer data stores were in-scope). The vendor used a white-box + authenticated testing approach against staging and production slices per our normal change window.

About methodology and acceptability: Redwood qualifies vendors that meet OWASP ASVS level 2 and the CREST or OSCP-equivalent reporting practices. We also require non-trivial sampling of patch-verified CVEs and confirmation of exploit attempts for high-risk findings. For procurement acceptance we can provide:  

- redacted signed report (PDF)
- evidence_manifest_2026.csv: list of artifacts (screenshots, log snippets, hashes) with brief descriptions
- scan_logs_sample_2026.tar.gz (sample of IDS/scan logs, redacted PII)

If Acme requires an NDA before handing over full workpapers we can accommodate — let us know. Otherwise we will sanitize and provide the redaction-ready files.

A couple of asks on our side so we hand you exactly what you need:  
1) Which SIG fields do you plan to populate from the redacted report vs the manifest? (e.g., finding counts, remediation status, scope text)
2) Do you need evidence of remediation verification (retest) for any specific findings, or is a remediation status matrix acceptable?

Rishi and Mina will coordinate the delivery.

-Karthik
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik / Rishi —

Thanks for the detail. Two clarifications from the GRC reviewers:  

- For the SIG spreadsheet we will extract the finding counts and remediation status from the redacted report and use the manifest for artifact references. So both files are required.
- They asked specifically for remediation verification for any "Critical" findings. If those are present in the report, we need either a retest confirmation or evidence of compensating controls plus a planned retest date.

I've attached the SIG template in case it's helpful (attachment: acme_sig_template.xlsx). If you can include a short note in the manifest that maps "Critical" findings to retest or compensating control evidence, that will expedite the committee review.

Julia
